module.name: data-grid
module.title: Data grid
module.description: A progressive layer over DataTable: roving cell focus, column visibility and width, and windowed row fetches. Sort, search and pagination stay server-owned, and the pager is never removed.

ui.name: column-picker
ui.summary: Renders per-column visibility checkboxes inside a native disclosure.
ui.guidance: Checkboxes in a details element, not a custom menu: the state is a set of independent toggles, which is exactly what a checkbox group is, and the platform already supplies the keyboard model. The picker starts hidden because hiding a column has no effect without the controller.

ui.name: data-grid
ui.guidance: The table is a real table with real headers, and the enhancement adds cell focus and column controls on top of it. It is deliberately not role="grid": that role promises a full two-dimensional keyboard model, and claiming it while the page still behaves like a table is worse for a screen-reader user than the honest table semantics they already understand.
ui.keyboard: Arrow keys move cell focus, Home/End jump to the row's ends (with Ctrl/Cmd, to the grid's first or last cell) and PageUp/PageDown move ten rows; a cell containing a text control keeps its own keys.

ui.name: grid-toolbar
ui.summary: Renders search plus the column picker trigger.
